sentences.text: allegation has been levelled against the petitioner.
He further submits that there is no chance of the petitioner being absconded or tampering with the evidence.
He lastly submits that the petitioner is languishing in custody since 10.03.2025.
Thus, he may be enlarged on bail.
5. Learned A.P.P. opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Having regard to the facts of the case and looking to the allegation made against this petitioner, so also the fact that this case arises out of a complaint case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the present Bail Application is allowed.

The 2025:JHHC:14417 petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned J.M. 1st Class, Dhanbad, in connection with Complaint Case No.2578 of 2019.

7. It is made clear that the petitioner shall appear on each and every date before the learned Trial Court and he shall not threaten any witness and shall co-operate in trial and if any adverse report will come against this petitioner, learned Trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of this petitioner.
